_readme: Placeholder trail. The historic creeds (Apostles' Creed, Nicene Creed, etc.) haven't been added yet -- add 'creed_line' waypoints here when ready, one per line of the creed, matching the existing WaypointType. No verse waypoints yet, so this place never auto-unlocks -- that's intentional until real content exists.
title: Creeds
description: Historic Christian creeds — like the Apostles' Creed and the Nicene Creed — that summarize the core beliefs of the faith in a few memorized lines. Coming soon.
